reasoning_traces.think:
The audit integrates static scanning with browser-based measurement to detect responsive design flaws. Static rules (R1–R5) flag potential issues but cannot verify dynamic behaviors like text wrapping or overflow. Dynamic measurement via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) provides empirical data on scrollWidth vs clientWidth and bounding rectangles at key breakpoints. Touch target analysis applies a 44px threshold to ensure accessibility. The failure mode occurs when static inspection misses layout inconsistencies that manifest only in runtime environments. This dual approach ensures robustness against false positives from static analysis while maintaining reproducibility.
